name: ANSI/IEEE Star-star-delta three-winding transformer form
summary: IEEE-library form of star-star-delta three-winding transformer: a star-star-delta transformer includes two star-connected winding sets and a delta tertiary winding.
description: This reference locates star-star-delta three-winding transformer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. A star-star-delta transformer includes two star-connected winding sets and a delta tertiary winding. The schematic needs all three winding ratings and the intended tertiary connection. The public library uses HXF1T15 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

Trace the tertiary separately so its protection and terminal status remain visible. A delta tertiary is a third winding, not an alternative connection of the main secondary. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
